headline: Recommended approval of first reading of Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, second reading of two revised policies, a teacher nomination, and extra-duty assignments.
summary: Superintendent Robinson reported three staff resignations and gave a district update. Donations to three schools were shared, and several staff nominations and extra-duty assignments were recommended for approval.
decisions: Recommended approval of the first reading of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, 7-0.
Recommended approval of the draft minutes of the September 23, 2026 Regular School Committee Meeting, 7-0.
Recommended approval of Director Hale to the Bangor High School Scholarship Fund, 7-0.
Recommended approval of John Tennett as Interim Principal of Fruit Street School for the 2026-2027 school year, 7-0.
Recommended approval of Michael Kunz as Science Teacher at Bangor High School for the 2026-2027 school year, with a one-year probationary contract, 7-0.
Recommended approval of extra-duty assignments for 18 staff members for the 2026-2027 school year, 7-0.
Reported donations to Abraham Lincoln School, Vine Street School, and William S. Cohen School; vote was 7-0.
Recommended approval of the second reading of Revised Policy EBCF (Automated External Defibrillators) and Revised Policy GDB-9 (Supplemental Compensation Guide), 7-0.

# MINUTES

## BANGOR SCHOOL COMMITTEE

## REGULAR MEETING

7:00 p.m., Thursday, October 15, 2026

School Committee Members Present: Chair Tim Surrette, Vice Chair Katie Brydon, Mallory Cook, Sara Luciano, Shelly Okere, Ben Speed, and Ben Sprague.

A. 1. & 2. The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m. by Chair Tim Surrette and the pledge of allegiance followed.

B. Adjustments to the Agenda:

No adjustments to the agenda

C. Public Comments:

No public comments

D. 1. a. Recommendation to approve the first reading of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan.

Motion: Brydon | Second: Okere | Vote: 7-0

D. 2. a. BIMS provided an introduction of their firm to the Committee.

b. Superintendent Robinson provided a district update to the committee.

c. Superintendent Robinson reported the following resignations:

| Name | Position | School |
|---|---|---|
| Maynard Walton | History Teacher | Bangor High School |
| James Strout | A Baseball Coach | James F. Doughty School |
| Isaac Bushway | B Girls Basketball Coach | William S. Cohen School |

E. 1. a. 1. Recommendation to approve the draft Minutes of the September 23, 2026 Regular School Committee Meeting.

Motion: Brydon | Second: Okere | Vote: 7-0

b. 1. Recommendation to approve Director Hale to the Bangor High School Scholarship Fund.

Motion: Brydon | Second: Okere | Vote: 7-0

c. 1. Recommendation to approve the following administrator nomination for the 2026-2027 school year:

| Name | Position | School |
|---|---|---|
| John Tennett | Interim Principal | Fruit Street School |

Motion: Brydon | Second: Surette | Vote: 7-0

2. Recommendation to approve the following teacher nomination for the 2026-2027 school year, with a one-year probationary contract:

| Name | Position | School |
|---|---|---|
| Michael Kunz | Science Teacher | Bangor High School |

Motion: Brydon | Second: Sprague | Vote: 7-0

3. Recommendation to approve the following extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 School Year.

| Name | Assignment | School |
|---|---|---|
| Sara Vozza | (.1) IEP Coord | Mary Snow School |
| Brooke Martin | (.1) IEP Coord | Mary Snow School |
| Tracy Reardon | (.45) IEP Coord | Mary Snow School |
| Heidi Robinson | (.45) IEP Coord | Mary Snow School |
| Kassie Saucier | (.45) IEP Coord | Mary Snow School |
| Scott Talcove | (.45) IEP Coord | Mary Snow School |
| Page Cadorette | (.6) IEP Coord | Downeast School |
| Jennifer Kolvoord | (.6) IEP Coord | Downeast School |
| Melissa Metivier | (.6) IEP Coord | Downeast School |
| Kasha Robertson | (.3) IEP Coord | Downeast School |
| Allyson Barnard | (.3) IEP Coord | Downeast School |
| Holly Rand | (.3) IEP Coord | Downeast School |
| Deidre Yeo | (.33) IEP Coord | Vine Street School |
| Justin Davis | Asst. Fresh Football Coach | Bangor High School |
| Robert Spreng | Asst Coach V. Baseball | Bangor High School |
| Chelsea Lowe | (.5) Yearbook Advisor | James F. Doughty School |
| Heather Hopkins | (.5) Graduation Coordinator | Bangor High School |
| Jane Venturelli | (.5) Graduation Coordinator | Bangor High School |

Motion: Brydon | Second: Okere | Vote: 7-0

d. Committee Member Ben Speed shared the following donations:

To Abraham Lincoln School from Quirk Subaru of Bangor, school supplies and adopt a classroom funding to support students, having a total dollar value of $4,200.

To Vine Street School from Realty of Maine, a cash donation to support students, having a total dollar value of $100.

To William S. Cohen School from Mrs Judi Sykes, in memory of Dan Sykes, a cash donation to support the Cohen Food Pantry, having a total dollar value of $100.

Motion: Brydon | Second: Okere | Vote: 7-0

e. Recommendation to approve Second Reading of the following Revised Policies:

1. Revised Policy EBCF - Automated External Defibrillators

2. Revised Policy GDB-9 - Supplemental Compensation Guide

Motion: Brydon | Second: Okere | Vote: 7-0

F. 2. Vice Chair Brydon provided an update from the UTC Committee.

Vice Chair Brydon provided an update from the Community of Belonging Committee.

3. Member Vijay provided an update from the Bangor High School.

H. Member Speed praised the communications team for the School Department, he has enjoyed the recent student activities posts.

Vice Chair Brydon also praised the school communications as well as the administration following the incident at William S. Cohen School last week.

Member Luciano gave praise for the handling of the recent threat at the William S. Cohen School.

I. 1. Important dates were reviewed by Chair Tim Surrette.

J. Recommended to adjourn the meeting at 8:19 p.m.

Motion: Brydon | Second: Sprague | Vote: 7-0

Respectfully Submitted,

Marie Robinson, Ph.D.

Superintendent of Schools
